UPDATE: Color changes added; Cursor trailer added; Clouds added; under clock you can now remove "animated by MamiXayah"

UPDATE: (April 2025): moveable clock + moveable butterfly; circular star rail cycle. Enjoy.

𝐈𝐌𝐏𝐎𝐑𝐓𝐀𝐍𝐓:

In Case you experience 𝐅𝐏𝐒 𝐃𝐑𝐎𝐏𝐒, try the following settings:

- 1. Scroll down on the wallpaper and go to "𝐀𝐝𝐝𝐢𝐭𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐒𝐞𝐭𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬". Turn off "𝐁𝐥𝐨𝐨𝐦", which should be enabled by default.
- 2. After that go to "𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐫𝐬" and turn off the following: "reactive stars (both additonal and default) , Red Stars, Glowing 
      stars (both additonal and default), shining stars and blinking stars"
- 3. After that go to "𝐀𝐧𝐢𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧" and turn off "𝐄𝐦𝐛𝐞𝐫"
- 4. If all of these changes aren't enough, go to 𝐖𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐩𝐚𝐩𝐞𝐫 𝐄𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐞 𝐒𝐞𝐭𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬 in the top right corner. From there on on the "Performance Tab" set FPS capped to 15. (Trust me it doesn't look bad, I use the same Setting.)
- 5. The last step from here on is to turn off Anti-Aliasing. 
- 6. In case you want to see if you get the consistent 15 FPS: Turn on "Show FPS" under "Clock".
  I hope this fixed all issues!
